description.value: Garlic N Pepper is a family-run Korean/Japanese grocery store and eatery in Courtenay that has been operating since 2019. It stocks a notably broad Asian grocery selection — 30+ ramen varieties, Korean and Japanese sauces, snacks, frozen foods, and house-made small-batch kimchi — that would be hard to find elsewhere in the Comox Valley. The eatery side serves hot Korean comfort food including bibimbap, bulgogi, spicy pork, and mandu, available for dine-in, pickup, or delivery.
